scope: Focused workspace, graph-selection and landscape-camera recipe validation; no new transform or browser usability claim.

tests.name: Nondefault workspace, graph views, source identity and landscape camera roundtrip exactly
Layout resize and arrangement do not alter selected evidence, frames, values or body calibration
Graph and lineage choices are display recipes, not queue-state changes
Workspace validates explicit units, full shape, finite integer bounds and supported version
Unknown structure, workspace and landscape versions are rejected rather than replaced
Structure identity must resolve in the currently shown source case and side
Graph views require their explicit recipe and reject unsupported lineage source/channel
Landscape camera and coefficient selection obey explicit schema and permitted prefix
Saved effective layout/camera/identity tampering disagrees with its recipe and is rejected
All existing examples restore exactly without injecting new presentation settings
Validation and restore leave the retained bundle byte exact
